opening.argument: The offer is framed around acquiring Luna tokens, promising “up to 10 dollar and Luna tokens” while directing viewers to a campaign link. Participation requires personal and account information: viewers are told to “enter your email,” provide a Binance user ID and Luna address, and complete a quiz before submitting the form. The process therefore combines a low-barrier reward with requests for information and a required submission. Separately, the speaker promotes joining Binance through a personal link for a “20% trade face discount for whole life.” These incentives are presented as benefits tied to registration and participation, although the record does not establish that any reward, discount, or transfer was completed.
